intro: The two biggest AI song generators, same prompts, side by side. Listen blind, pick a winner, then see which tool made which track.

a: Fifty credits a day, that's ten songs before lunch
Udio hands you ten, man, that ain't even a brunch
Custom lyrics, extend it, remix it, I'm the blueprint they chase
Every 'Suno alternative' list, I'm the reason it's a race
b: Polished mixes, that's the word on the street
You got the volume, I got the master, I'm the one with the heat
Inpainting on deck, I can fix a single line
Same ten bucks a month, but my vocals sit fine

rounds.title: Trap verse
rounds.prompt: Dark trap beat, 140 BPM, confident male rap vocal about staying up all night writing rhymes, heavy 808s, hi-hat rolls
rounds.inputs: Default model, custom lyrics off, first generation kept (no cherry-picking). Trim to the first 30 seconds.

rounds.title: Boom bap with your own lyrics
rounds.prompt: 90s boom bap, 90 BPM, dusty drums, jazzy piano sample, laid-back male rap vocal
rounds.inputs: Custom lyrics mode with the same 8 bars pasted into both tools (the shared lyrics at /battles/suno-vs-udio/lyrics.txt). First generation kept.
